source_status.user_supplied_evidence: 2026-05-28 screenshot of Reddit warning showing Corvette build boundary visualization and reporting boundary around 100m / little under 330 ft.
source_status.user_correction_v48: Boundary applies to the total Corvette footprint including non-Corvette/base/decorative parts placed on or in the Corvette, not only Category == Corvette objects.
source_status.official_context: Swarm/6.40 patch notes include Corvette-adjacent stability and performance work but do not explicitly confirm the 100m boundary in reviewed sources.

generator_requirements: Audit the entire final Corvette assembly, not only Category == Corvette objects.
Include all non-Corvette/base/decorative parts placed on or in the Corvette.
Use occupied rotated bounding boxes, not center-only checks.
Use FBX extents multiplied by scale for each ObjectID.
Map rotated part extents into world axes before computing bounds.
Fail or redesign if any total build axis span exceeds 95m.
Print final X/Y/Z spans in validation report.
Reject imported/third-party Corvette blueprints over 95m side length.
boundary_audit_includes: non-Corvette exterior decorations mounted on the Corvette
non-Corvette interior decorations and furniture placed in the Corvette
lights, signs, decals, pipes, greebles, plants, props, or kitbash elements that remain in the final Corvette export
any helper/scaffold/template object that remains in the final Corvette export
boundary_audit_excludes: temporary generation templates not exported as part of the Corvette
external labels/debug grids/reference markers not exported as part of the Corvette

applies_to: Blender/save-editor/third-party blueprints intended for Corvette use
any non-Corvette/base/decorative part placed on or in the Corvette
does_not_apply_to: decorative non-Corvette builds using Corvette ObjectIDs as greebles
